messages:
devon_sales: Heads-up — BrightLane go-live is tomorrow 09:00 PT but field team hit a blocker during private deploy. Need quick triage.

devon_sales: Customer reports the on-prem gateway rejects our marketplace image with TLS errors. Logs show: 
2026-03-20T22:12:34Z kubelet: container start failed: tls: certificate signed by unknown authority

sarah_partnerships: @mike_solutions can you join? We need an architecture review + a short-term workaround for hypercare.

mike_solutions: on it. quick q — is this failing at image pull or at app startup?

devon_sales: image pull succeeds (200). kube starts container but the app fails the TLS handshake when it hits customer backend.

anya_eng: Likely their proxy/IDS is stripping or replacing cert chain. Two short-term options: 1) add our signing CA to their trust store; 2) do TLS termination at their DMZ (edge TLS) and speak plain internally.

nina_security: We can't recommend permanent plain-text. For a temporary fix we can produce a marketplace image signed with the customer's CA if they can provide a CSR + signing permission via a secure upload. Needs legal OK for key handling.

sarah_partnerships: @devon_sales open a secure upload link and request their root CA bundle. Also let's do a 30m arch review — proposing 08:30 PT. Attendees: field-eng, solutions, security.

devon_sales: Invite sent for 08:30 PT. I'm collecting logs and the gateway config now. Sample command we asked them to run: 
```
curl -v --cacert /tmp/customer-ca.pem https://internal-service.brightlane.local/health
```

devon_sales: Their reply included this kubelet snippet: 
```
Mar 20 22:11:02 node kubelet[1234]: E0320 22:11:02.123456    1234 manager.go:123] Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to allocate network: tls: certificate signed by unknown authority
```

deploy-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-4312 BrightLane private deploy - cert mismatch. Pager: field-eng-oncall. Link: https://redwood.inc/INC-4312

mike_solutions: For longer-term: add a 'custom CA' option in Private docs + a marketplace flow for customer-signed images. I'll draft a PR for the docs + a checklist for SI handoffs.

anya_eng: If customer refuses to share CA/keys, fallback is ingress edge TLS termination in their DMZ (we'll need a network diagram). Not ideal but low-risk for go-live.

nina_security: I'll block off time in the review to cover KMS/HSM and signing constraints. We should avoid transferring private keys over email — use the secure upload only.

sarah_partnerships: I'll coordinate with marketplace partner to see if they can fast-track a manual signed-image publish while we sort automation.

devon_sales: Thanks all — I'll update INC-4312 with outcomes from the 08:30 call. :thumbsup:

sarah_partnerships: Great. Post any logs in the ticket and ping me if they share the CA bundle so I can route it to security.

mike_solutions: Noted. Will include checklist: trust-store update steps, ingress option, image-signing flow, and rollback plan.

devon_sales: Closing loop for now. Will report back after the call.
